---
name: Clock problem
about: Report a reproducible problem on the MM32 + ESP8285 board
title: ''
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

**Hardware**
Confirm MM32SPIN05PF + ESP8285, supply type and whether a programmer/debugger was connected.

**Versions and settings**
MM32 version, ESP version, movement style, seconds battery saver, timezone/DST mode.

**What happened**
What you pressed/saved, expected result, actual result, approximate time and whether it repeats.

**Hands and LEDs**
Hand positions, red-only/blue/simultaneous flashes, numbered fault if any. For uneven seconds, note whether it followed a hold, wake, Save or catch-up.

Do not attach passwords, tokens, full flash dumps or unredacted private captures.
